format: C++/Objective-C++, specifically for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) framework
description: This file contains the implementation of a custom bincount function optimized for Apple’s Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend, including setup of MPS computational graphs and integration with PyTorch tensors. It defines an internal implementation function `bincount_mps_impl` and a public API `_bincount_mps`.

classes.name: CachedGraph
classes.description: A class inheriting from MPSCachedGraph that caches MPSGraph tensors related to the bincount operation, including input, output, scatter data, and weights tensors.

methods.name: bincount_mps_impl
methods.description: Internal static function that constructs and runs an MPS graph to perform the bincount operation with optional weights, managing tensor placeholders and caching.

methods.name: _bincount_mps
methods.description: Public wrapper function that validates inputs, manages optional weights, computes bin count size, and calls `bincount_mps_impl` to perform the actual computation.
